name: raya-fonts
title: Raya Fonts
description: Optional font wiring for the five built-in Raya faces (Inter, Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono, Geist Mono). Skip if you self-host per System export instructions.
docs:
Import in your styles.css (anywhere after tailwindcss):

@import "./styles/raya/fonts.css";
